summary: The note describes four bonus tracks added to the single release of "Vilaiyaadu Mankatha". All four were previously part of soundtracks composed by Yuvan Shankar Raja and were marketed by Sony Music Entertainment. The songs were included in their original composition without any variation.
one_line: Four earlier Yuvan Shankar Raja soundtrack songs were added as bonus tracks to the Vilaiyaadu Mankatha single, released by Sony Music Entertainment.
key_facts: Four songs were included as bonus tracks to the single release of "Vilaiyaadu Mankatha".
All four bonus tracks were part of earlier soundtracks by Yuvan Shankar Raja.
The bonus tracks were marketed by Sony Music Entertainment.
"Dia Dia Dole" was performed by Suchitra for the film "Avan Ivan".
"Goa" is from the same-titled film and features vocals by Krish, Ranjith, Tanvi Shah, Suchitra, Chynk Showtyme and Pav Bundy.
"Yogi Yogi Thaan" is from "Yogi" and is sung by Blaaze and Neha Bhasin.
The title track from "Theeradha Vilaiyattu Pillai" is rendered by Andrea Jeremiah, Tanvi Shah, Vinaitha and Ranjith.
The four songs were added in their original composition without any variation.
